role: Central constants: app/group/iCloud/keychain identifiers and container lookup, the UserDefaults key registry, unit conversions, HRV/sleep/training thresholds, composite recovery-score weights (ScoringWeights), score bounds and Kubios-style stress normative references.
types: AppConfig: enum — identifiers, developer contact address + contactMailURL(subject:body:), sharedContainerURL()
UnitConstants / SessionConstants: enum — unit conversions and session age limit
HRVConstants (RRInterval, MinimumDuration, MinimumBeats, FrequencyBands, DFA, Artifacts, RRValidity): enum — HRV analysis thresholds
TrainingConstants (ACR, TRIMP, EWMA): enum — load model constants
ScoringWeights (Tier3, Tier2, Comeback, Sleep, PerceivedReadiness, Vitals): enum — composite recovery-score weights and vitals sub-score rules
StressNormativeConstants: enum — PNS/SNS references and 1-10 readiness deltas
state: mem:AppConfig.contactEmail = chrissharp80@gmail.com (static let; support, privacy, AI-report mail and the contact in third-party User-Agent strings)
mem:AppConfig.resolvedSharedContainerURL (static let, resolved once per process)
toplevel: Only static let constants outside the units (AppConfig.resolvedSharedContainerURL is initialised lazily from resolveSharedContainerURL() on first use); no conformances or #if blocks.

units.does: Builds a mailto: URL to AppConfig.contactEmail via URLComponents with a 'subject' query item and, when body is non-nil, a 'body' query item (percent-encoded by URLComponents); returns components.url (nil only if URLComponents cannot form a URL).

branches.effect: adds a body query item; otherwise subject only

units.does: Returns the per-process cached container URL (resolvedSharedContainerURL, set once from resolveSharedContainerURL()): the App Group container, else Documents, else NSTemporaryDirectory(). Used for settings, saved routes, baselines, diagnostics, crash logs, the debug log, workout track backups and the fresh-install wipe.

Resolves the App Group container URL for group.com.chrissharp.flowrecovery; if unavailable NSLogs and falls back to Documents, and if that cannot be resolved NSLogs and returns NSTemporaryDirectory(). NSLog, not debugLog, because DebugLogger's initialiser reaches this through sharedContainerURL().
units.entry: Lazy initialiser of AppConfig.resolvedSharedContainerURL (first sharedContainerURL() call)

branches.cond: App Group container URL resolves (entitlement present)
branches.effect: true: return it; false: fall through — files written to the fallback are not visible to extensions sharing the group
true: NSLog 'App Group container … unavailable; using Documents' and return Documents; false: NSLog and return the temporary directory

units.does: Returns true when the RR interval in ms is within 300...2000 (physiological range ~30-200 bpm).

True when an HR-detected onset latencyMs after the recording start (wall clock) is at most maxHREstimatedOnsetLatencyMin (20 min, inclusive). The one cap test the three HR onset detectors share; a later detection is treated by each caller as a misfire (onset undetermined), not moved to minute 20.
